rows.grounds: compound of krośa (distance measure), mātra (measure), sthita (stood)

items.question: Who should bow to the guru daily?
items.inference: Even a disciple a krośa away must salute the guru each day.
uncertainties: exact length of a krośa is unspecified
namet may be optative or imperative in context
items.plain_english: A disciple standing a krośa away should bow to the guru every day.
